complements.rule: unchanged and binding, except the v2 case superseded by v3
unchanged and binding, except response_schemas.status_unknown and one metadata field (see supersedes)

supersedes.why: status_unknown.reason is only pending | not_found_or_expired (WisKey answer (e), agreed by Arx). The v3 schema also allowed unconfirmed, interrupted and outcome_persistence_failed. No v3 case changes outcome: every v3 status_unknown expected_response uses pending or not_found_or_expired.
Code points are not defined for invalid UTF-8. The refusal (encoding/invalid_utf8) and the byte count (8193) stay binding.

test_hmac_key.encoding: UTF-8 bytes of the string are the HMAC key
test_hmac_key.warning: TEST CONSTANT ONLY (the same public constant as v1-v3). Never use as, or derive, a pairing secret.

contract_addendum.station_rule: door_open for a station that is not registered, whose entry is not loaded, or that has no verified active mapping is state/relay_not_allowed: after the capability check, before any pending record. No fallback to a lock entity or to another station; station is matched exactly.

response_schema.stations: list of {station, allowed_relays, mapping_revision}, closed objects, station unique
response_schema.station: string, the opaque ConfigEntry.entry_id, 1-128 code points, no C0/DEL/C1
response_schema.allowed_relays: list of unique integers >= 1 (physical_index of the verified active mapping only); empty = selection disabled for that station
response_schema.mapping_revision: opaque string, 1-128 code points, no C0/DEL/C1, compared for equality only (Arx proposal; WisKey to confirm)

rules: a hint for display and selection only, never an authorization; every open is checked against WisKey's active mapping and Arx RBAC stays the only authority
service missing, timeout, error, malformed or unknown schema_version: selection disabled, cached list dropped, no guessing, no lock fallback
refresh on discovery, reload and mapping_revision change; relay_not_allowed invalidates the cache and refreshes, with no retry and no alternate relay
the cache is invalidated by a bridge restart
mapping_revision is not part of the signed door_open envelope

clock_signal.source: Supervisor /host/info of the host that runs the bridge: dt_synchronized and dt_utc
clock_signal.rule: healthy only if the Supervisor is available, the sample was read without error after the last bridge restart, its age by the bridge's monotonic clock is <= 30000 ms (inclusive), dt_synchronized is exactly boolean true and dt_utc is a valid UTC time. Otherwise time/clock_invalid; no fallback (use_ntp or OS NTP status are ignored).
clock_signal.does_not_replace: the floor, the stored high-water, the 2000 ms divergence check and the no-future-tolerance window, all checked on every open
clock_signal.dt_utc_model_rule: RFC 3339 UTC with Z or +00:00, optional fraction of 1-6 digits, a real date (model only; the exact Supervisor format and versions go to COMPAT.md, planned 2026-10-08)

anchor.rule: bootstrap only with a healthy signal AND UTC >= floor, written atomically (write failure blocks); the high-water advances only from healthy samples, before dispatch and before replay purge; write failure blocks; never an automatic decrease; a decrease only by the owner after: trusted calls stopped, HMAC-material generation rotated, old-generation signatures verified rejected, then an atomic decrease and a UTC/monotonic re-baseline; pending and replay are kept; without a generation change the block lasts until UTC >= high-water. Unavailable until the HMAC rotation procedure is approved.

metadata_corrections.why: the input is not valid UTF-8, so a code-point count is not defined (the v3 value counted U+FFFD replacements). The refusal encoding/invalid_utf8 and signed_message_utf8_bytes = 8193 stay binding.

case_format.signed: the v3 case fields (signed_message_json, service_data_json, digests, expected_dto for accept/stateful, state_setup, expected_side_effects, response_schema, expected_response, forbidden_responses); expected_side_effects adds fallback_used (always false)

state_setup_additions.station_registry: station -> {loaded, mapping: verified_active | unverified | none, physical_indexes}; station_relays is the verified active part of it (stations not listed are unknown)
state_setup_additions.lock_fallback_configured: true = a lock entity exists for the door; it must still never be used as a fallback
state_setup_additions.clock_signal: {supervisor: available | absent, sample: null | {read: ok | error | timeout, age_ms, bridge_restarted_since_read, body: the /host/info subset or null}, ignored_other_sources?}

case_format.capabilities_model: trigger (discovery | reload | revision_change | open_rejected_relay_not_allowed | bridge_restart | display), cache_before, service_call (null = no answer yet | {outcome: ok, response_json} | {outcome: service_missing | timeout | error}), open_response?, expected_selection {enabled, reason, stations}, expected_cache_after, expected_actions
case_format.anchor_scenario: initial_state, then steps in order; each step has op, inputs and expect (the observable result). Ops: bootstrap, sample, open, replay_purge, stop_trusted_calls, rotate_hmac_generation, verify_old_generation_rejected, re_anchor_decrease, resume_trusted_calls. hmac_generation is an abstract label: no second key exists in this package.
case_format.model_only: true on every capabilities, clock and anchor case; verified is false: no runtime or real system was involved

response_schema_dialect: JSON Schema 2020-12 subset: type, const, enum, pattern, properties, required, additionalProperties, oneOf (as in v3).

cases.reason: door_open_status for an open stored as unknown/unconfirmed. The only valid answer is stored_result with outcome unknown/unconfirmed. A top-level status_unknown with reason unconfirmed is forbidden: the corrected status_unknown schema refuses it (the v3 schema still allowed it).

forbidden_responses.why: status_unknown.reason is only pending or not_found_or_expired; unconfirmed belongs in door_open_unknown or in a stored_result outcome

cases.reason: door_open_status for an open stored as unknown/interrupted. The only valid answer is stored_result with outcome unknown/interrupted. A top-level status_unknown with reason interrupted is forbidden: the corrected status_unknown schema refuses it (the v3 schema still allowed it).

forbidden_responses.why: status_unknown.reason is only pending or not_found_or_expired; interrupted belongs in door_open_unknown or in a stored_result outcome

cases.reason: door_open_status for an open stored as unknown/outcome_persistence_failed. The only valid answer is stored_result with outcome unknown/outcome_persistence_failed. A top-level status_unknown with reason outcome_persistence_failed is forbidden: the corrected status_unknown schema refuses it (the v3 schema still allowed it).

forbidden_responses.why: status_unknown.reason is only pending or not_found_or_expired; outcome_persistence_failed belongs in door_open_unknown or in a stored_result outcome

cases.reason: station test_station_unknown is not registered with WisKey. Refused after the capability check and before any pending record. No fallback to a lock entity (one is configured) and none to test_station_entrance.
test_station_side is registered but its entry is not loaded; its last known mapping {1, 2} is not active. Refused; no fallback to test_station_entrance (loaded, relay 1 mapped) or to a lock.

test_station_side is loaded and has no mapping at all.
station Test_Station_Entrance differs from the loaded test_station_entrance only by case. Exact match: unknown; never resolved to the other station.
Unknown station AND no capability. The capability check runs first in stage state, so the code is capability_missing (two defects on purpose: this case binds the order capability -> relay mapping).

Unknown station AND a pending-record write that would fail. The mapping check runs before the pending record, so the code is relay_not_allowed, not storage_unavailable (two defects on purpose: binds mapping -> pending).
